canonical_statement: Every finite-dimensional Hausdorff second-countable boundaryless smooth real manifold admits a smooth embedding into some finite-dimensional real Euclidean space.
domain_and_universes: universes uE uH uM; E : Type uE; H : Type uH; M : Type uM; result in Prop
conclusion: There exist n : Nat and e : M -> EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n) such that e is infinitely ContMDiff, IsEmbedding e, and mfderiv I (R n) e x is injective for every x.

scope_boundaries.dimension: The target dimension is existential; neither the weak 2m+1 nor strong 2m bound is substituted.
scope_boundaries.compactness: No CompactSpace hypothesis occurs; the existing pinned compact theorem is a strict specialization and cannot close this root.
scope_boundaries.boundary: BoundarylessManifold makes the intake exclusion of manifolds with boundary explicit.
scope_boundaries.embedding: The conclusion spells out smoothness, topological embedding, and pointwise injective manifold derivative rather than relying on the currently incomplete Manifold.IsSmoothEmbedding API.

mutations: replaced existential target dimension by 2 * finrank Real E + 1
weakened smooth embedding to continuous injection

status_boundary: This phase freezes and kernel-elaborates the broad existence-only proposition. It provides no inhabitant of the proposition and makes no proof-completion claim.
